---
name: Add call recording
about: Record calls and save to storage
title: "[FEATURE] Call recording"
labels: enhancement
---

**Description**
Users should be able to record calls and save them for later review.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- [ ] Toggle recording on/off during active call
- [ ] Save recording as WebM/MP3
- [ ] Store recordings in backend or cloud storage
- [ ] Play back recordings from call history
- [ ] Download recordings

**Additional context**
Legal requirements vary by jurisdiction. Add a disclaimer about recording laws.
